sections.visual_description: A lone figure standing at the edge of a vast construction site, holding a long wooden lever that extends into the clouds. Ancient Greek archimedes lever metaphor meets modern technology. Misty atmosphere with beams of light breaking through. Pen and ink sketch style with loose crosshatching, New Yorker editorial illustration aesthetic.
sections.caption: Tools as Levers

sections.h2_title: 第一部分：效率进化的核心洞察
sections.visual_description: A spiral staircase made of glass and steel ascending through clouds, with some steps glowing warmly while others remain transparent. A small figure climbing upward, looking back at the winding path below. Represents the journey from illusion to real evolution. Minimalist architectural drawing style, black ink with subtle red accents.
sections.caption: Spiral of Evolution

sections.h2_title: 第二部分：实际落地的价值验证
sections.visual_description: An artisan's workbench with traditional tools scattered alongside holographic AI interfaces. Blueprints unfurl across the wooden surface, half hand-drawn and half digitally rendered. A vintage brass compass rests next to glowing circuit patterns. Still life composition, detailed pen and ink with selective red highlights on key instruments.
sections.caption: Old and New Tools

sections.h2_title: 第三部分：效率进化的七个建议
sections.visual_description: Seven stepping stones arranged across a calm stream, each stone inscribed with different symbols representing workflow, memory, permissions, and validation. A pathway leading from chaos to order. Zen garden aesthetic meets technical diagram. Simple ink wash style with clean lines and generous white space.
sections.caption: Seven Stepping Stones

sections.h2_title: 第四部分：NanoClaw 折腾实录
sections.visual_description: A tangled mess of garden hoses and irrigation pipes in a greenhouse, with water pooling in unexpected places. Among the chaos, small shoots of plants are thriving. Represents debugging and system maintenance. Detailed observational drawing style, intricate line work showing both disorder and hidden order.
sections.caption: Garden of Debugging

sections.visual_description: A winding mountain path being constructed stone by stone, extending toward a distant horizon where sky meets land. The road is half-built, with construction materials and scaffolding visible. Dawn light breaking over the mountains. Epic landscape in minimalist ink style, emphasizing journey and potential.
sections.caption: Paving the Way
